Notify.AttackerAndTarget: Pyre: select an attacker and target a token (T) first.
Notify.TargetFirst: Pyre: target a token first (T) to test this effect.

Recipe.breath: Breath (cone or line from the caster)

Reveal.Label: Players saw a neutral strike. Replay as:
Reveal.Other: Show this to the players instead

adaptive.Hint: When effects make the game stutter, draw them at a lower resolution until it runs smoothly again.
adaptive.Name: Adaptive resolution

animatePostedCards.Hint: Also animate spell cards that were posted to chat without being cast.
animatePostedCards.Name: Animate posted spell cards

areaWithoutPlacing.Hint: Area spells wait for their area to be placed. If nobody places it and damage is rolled at targeted creatures, aim the area at them. Emanations always play around the caster at once.
areaWithoutPlacing.Name: Areas that are never placed

Choice.friendly: Only on my and allied tokens

auras.Hint: Lasting looks for conditions and spell effects (quickened, frightened, burning…).
auras.Name: Condition auras

bloom.Hint: How much bright effects bleed light around them. 0 turns it off.
bloom.Name: Glow (bloom)

breakableWalls.Hint: After an area's damage roll, walls it reaches can break; you confirm which. Each wall's material, Hardness and HP are set in the wall's own sheet; scene defaults and rules in Pyre Studio → Scene.
breakableWalls.Name: Breakable walls

debug.Hint: Show what Pyre decides for each attack and spell in a small box on screen, and write it to the console (F12).
debug.Name: Debug logging

defaultWallMaterial.Hint: For walls without their own material. Set walls one by one in Pyre Studio → Scene.
defaultWallMaterial.Name: Wall material (default)

enabled.Hint: Turn every Pyre effect on or off on this computer.
enabled.Name: Show effects

groundMarks.Hint: Scorch, frost, wet stone and cracks left on the floor for a few seconds.
groundMarks.Name: Ground marks

intensity.Hint: Scales how bright effects are on this computer.
intensity.Name: Brightness

markTime.Hint: How long scorch, frost, gashes and cracks stay on the floor.
markTime.Name: Ground mark duration (seconds)

persistentMarks.Hint: Scorch, frost and acid burns stay on the map after an area spell, until you clear them in Pyre Studio → Scene.
persistentMarks.Name: Lasting marks

quality.Hint: Low suits older laptops; High uses more particles and a sharper image.
quality.Name: Quality

screenShake.Hint: Shake and punch the map on heavy hits.
screenShake.Name: Screen shake and impact zoom

smokeTime.Hint: How long smoke and dust hang over the map and tokens. 1 is the full look; lower clears them sooner.
smokeTime.Name: Smoke and dust duration

studio.Hint: Test effects on the current scene and change how individual spells look.
studio.Label: Open Pyre Studio
studio.Name: Pyre Studio

tokenReactions.Hint: Struck tokens are pushed back, squash and flash. Purely visual; tokens never move on the map.
tokenReactions.Name: Token reactions

underTokens.Hint: Scorch, floor light, smoke, dust and casting circles are drawn beneath the tokens (reload to apply).
underTokens.Name: Floor effects under tokens

wallWeakness.Hint: Wood takes double from fire; stone double from sonic and more from bludgeoning and acid, half from fire and cold; metal double from acid; glass double from sonic and bludgeoning.
wallWeakness.Name: Materials react to damage types

wallsBlock.Hint: Bursts, breaths and other areas stop at walls that block movement, and creatures behind them do not react.
wallsBlock.Name: Walls stop areas

Msg.Broken: {n} wall(s) broken. Restore them here whenever you like.
Msg.NoneBroken: No broken walls in this scene.
Msg.NothingToChange: Nothing to change: pick a recipe, an element, colours or Off.
Msg.PickAttack: Type or pick an attack name first.
Msg.PickSpell: Type or pick a spell name first.
Msg.SceneMaterial: This scene's walls are now {name} unless set otherwise.
Msg.SelectToken: Select the token that casts or attacks first.
Msg.SelectWalls: Select walls on the Walls layer first.
Msg.TargetToken: Target a token (press T over it) to strike at.
Msg.WeaknessOff: Every damage type counts the same against walls.

Ov.AttacksHint: Pyre reads the weapon group, then the attack's name (Claw, Jaws, Longsword, Garra…). Pick a look for any attack it gets wrong. Applies to every attack with that name.
Ov.DarkNote: A very dark core switches to shadow rendering, with the glow on the rim.
Ov.Hint: Pyre reads each spell's data on its own. Use an override when a spell should look different: an enemy's black lightning, an ice fireball, or no animation at all.
Ov.None: No overrides yet. Every spell plays what its data describes.

Scene.MarksOff: Off: turn on Lasting marks in the module settings to keep scorch, frost and acid burns.
Scene.MarksOn: On: area spells leave scorch, frost and acid burns.
Scene.PerWall: Each wall's material, Hardness and HP: double-click the wall (its sheet has a Pyre section, with "apply to the selected walls"). Or select walls here and give them a material.
Scene.RubbleKept: Rubble from broken walls is always kept.
Scene.WallsHow: After an area's damage roll, walls it reaches take the damage minus their Hardness, and you choose which break.
Scene.WallsOff: Off: turn on Breakable walls in the module settings.
Scene.Weakness: Materials react to damage types (wood ×2 vs fire, stone ×2 vs sonic…)

Test.Hint: Select the token that acts, then target others with <kbd>T</kbd>. Tests play only on your screen.
Test.SpellsNote: Areas aim at your first target, or straight ahead without one.

AlsoApply.Many: Also apply to the other {n} selected walls
AlsoApply.One: Also apply to the other selected wall

Walls.Dealt: {name} dealt {total} damage. Tick the walls that break:
Walls.DialogHint: Unticked walls keep the damage. Broken walls can be restored from the chat card, the Walls controls or Pyre Studio.
Walls.NoneBroken: Pyre: no broken walls in this scene.
Walls.SectionHint: Empty fields use the material. Unbreakable ignores the numbers. Saves as you change it.

Batch.Title: Pyre: breakable walls

Target.wall: Every wall in this scene, not doors or windows ({n})

Batch.Hint: A new material brings its own Hardness and HP. Type numbers to use your own instead; leave them empty to keep what each wall has.
Batch.NoWalls: Pyre: no walls to change. Select some on the Walls layer, or pick another group.
